cards.d: If someone is bankrupt, then they are unable to pay their debts.
cards.e: The store had few customers and soon went bankrupt.

cards.d: To conform to rules or laws is to obey them.
cards.e: The new student had to conform to the school’s dress code.

cards.d: To employ someone means to give work to them.
cards.e: The bookstore employed two full-time clerks.

cards.d: To expel someone means to force them to leave a place.
cards.e: Since he would not follow the rules, the principal had to expel the student.

cards.d: An extension is a part added to something to give it more time or space.
cards.e: My parents decided to add an extension to our house for the new baby.

cards.d: If something is forthcoming, then it is about to happen in the future.
cards.e: Some economists predicted that the forthcoming world economy would be severe.

cards.d: To furnish means to put furniture in a house or room.
cards.e: Most homes are furnished with tables, chairs, and beds.

cards.d: Hygiene is the conditions or methods needed for health and cleanliness.
cards.e: People who brush their teeth at least twice a day are practicing good hygiene.

cards.d: If something is hygienic, then it is clean and unlikely to cause disease.
cards.e: My sister works very hard to keep her entire home as hygienic as possible.

cards.d: A landlord is a man who rents property to a person.
cards.e: The landlord collected everyone’s rent money on the first day of every month.

cards.d: To lease means to rent property, usually an apartment or land.
cards.e: When the family first leased the apartment, the rent was very low.

cards.d: If something is mandatory, then it is required by law.
cards.e: It’s mandatory that everyone be at least sixteen to drive a car in the US.

cards.d: To mend something means to fix it when it is broken or damaged.
cards.e: Mother mended the rip in my pants with a piece of cloth.

cards.d: A mortgage is a loan for property, especially homes and businesses.
cards.e: When they bought their new home, the married couple had to sign a mortgage.

cards.d: Personnel are employees in a business.
cards.e: When business increased, we had to hire more personnel.

cards.d: Plumbing is the system of pipes used in a home to supply water.
cards.e: When the plumbing stopped working, no one was allowed to use the toilets.

cards.d: A tenant is a person who rents property from a landlord.
cards.e: The new tenants moved into the house across the street.

cards.d: If something is trendy, then it is very popular and new.
cards.e: Carlo bought a trendy new car.

cards.d: A utility is a business that supplies services such as water or electricity.
cards.e: If you don’t pay the utilities, you may have your electricity turned off.

cards.d: Whereby means by which or through which.
cards.e: The mayor had a new bridge built whereby the citizens could cross the river.
